source_basis.limit: The 1768-turn/440-ohm winding is a K7222.25 repair; 0.92 coupling and 7–8 pF capacitance come from a different CRT LOPT. The original K7222.11 values are not measured.
source_basis.ac_loss_limit: 10-ohm low-turn and 5-kohm HV AC-loss proxies and skin fractions are assumed-bound, not measured .11 winding impedances.

high_voltage_coupling.rationale: Independent CRT LOPT study reports typical primary-to-overwind k 0.5–0.97 and measured example k=0.92. ÜHA78 replacement author reports EHT varies with overwind axial position; no .11 k measurement.
